row.title: Every deployment is a sandboxed tenant with its own repo
row.body: what-works moving; base-rates, did-it-work, open-questions planned; spinoffs retired. Tenant workers bind only their own stores, no core services or secrets, with a sampled daily budget. Repo creation waits on an org-scoped credential (sibling thread owns that route); tenant-repos.yml creates the four repos once one binds.

title: Every deployment is a sandboxed tenant with its own repo
